Study notes/Quantum Field Theory

Gauge Theory & Constrained Systems

Quantization of Constrained Systems: The Abelian Higgs Model as a Case Study.

Quantum Field Theory · 2026

An evolving outline of the Dirac–Bergmann formalism, constrained quantization, gauge fixing, and their relation to lattice gauge theory, with existing calculations preserved in appendices.

Read PDF ↗ (opens in a new tab) Download PDF ↓

About this note

Draft / work in progress. Sections 1–6 provide the intended organization of this note, rather than completed chapters. Prior calculations on gauge constraints, temporal and Coulomb gauges, and Dirac brackets remain available in the appendices for reference.

Planned contents

  1. Constrained Hamiltonian Systems
  2. The Abelian Higgs Model
  3. Gauge Fixing and Reduced Phase Space
  4. Quantization
  5. Comparing Quantization Schemes
  6. Connection to Lattice Gauge Theory

Companion: Toric Code Demystified develops the lattice gauge theory and toric-code application. The PDF introduction links to that note’s page on this site.
